derivation: Generated by `python tools/board_manifest.py` (this board's row, read through tools/import_board.py) from the vendor's own EAGLE 9.6.2 board file, element J1 (THING_PLUS). Pad centres are the coordinates the file states, in millimetres, with EAGLE's upward Y axis flipped once against a 22.86 x 58.42 mm outline taken from layer 20 (Dimension), plus a 1.0 mm margin. Pad names are the net each pad is on, from <signals>. Nothing here was measured off an image. Scaled at 8.0 px/mm.
assumption: Every `pin` is null: that field is the rcontrol pin index of a PICSimLab board implementation (webui/pinmap.py), and none exists for this board. `chip_pin` and `chip_index` are what tools/import_pindefs.py read out of the board-support packages named in `pindefs`; a pad whose `chip_pin` is null says why in `why_null`. webui/boards/esp32c6.py describes the ESP32-C6, and its table is keyed by the labels of XIAO-ESP32-C6-DIP, XIAO-ESP32-C6-SMD, which are not this board's; no level is read through it for any pad here, and `chip_pin` is recorded so that the join is ready, not made.

pindefs.derivation: Generated by tools/import_pindefs.py from the board-support packages in `packages`, at those revisions. Nothing was inferred from the CAD, the silkscreen or a pinout image: a label resolves only when every package covering the board that defines it names the same pin, and `python tools/import_pindefs.py <board>` prints the file that named it.
